name: 저녁 8시, 전화 네 통
flow: ④ 못 만난 부모에게는 저녁에 몰아서 전화
situation: 상담사 책상, 저녁. 수화기를 든 손, 옆에 빈 포스트잇 네 장.
caption: 기존 · 못 만난 부모에게는 저녁 8시에 전화 네 통
prompt:
Documentary photograph aesthetic, unretouched, fine film grain.

A counsellor's desk in a small centre office after hours. A woman's hands enter from the right edge; one hand holds the handset of a plain grey desk phone, the other hovers a fingertip over the keypad. Beside the phone four small plain sticky notes are lined up in a row, blank pastel squares. The moment before the first number. Tired, dutiful, unposed.

FG: the sticky notes, slightly below centre. MG: the hands and the desk phone, occupying the right third. BG: a plain wall and a shelf edge, softly defocused, the window beyond already dark.

Light: a warm desk lamp from the upper right and a cooler ceiling light overhead; the left side of the desk falls into shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The phone and the hands fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is calm bare desk, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: high three-quarter, just above desk height, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the fingertip over the keypad. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the shelf edge stays readable during a slow dolly in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: the end of a long working day, four calls to go.

The desk surface is bare and unmarked, the sticky notes blank, the phone plain and unbranded, every surface clean and free of lettering.

case.인물 · 시각: 보호자 이수진 · 상담사 정상담 · 16:50 대기실 → 20:00 상담사 책상
case.흐름: 회기가 끝나고 아이가 나온다 → 상담사가 서서 10분 "오늘 잘했어요, 블록 놀이 했고요" → 보호자는 가방을 받아 안주머니 녹음기를 끈다 → 못 만난 부모에게는 저녁 8시에 전화 네 통 → 그리고 같은 회기를 제출 양식에 다시 친다
case.이 A가 말하는 것: 고객이 산 것은 50분인데 받는 것은 10분의 말이다. 그래서 몰래 기록하고, 못 온 부모에게는 상담사의 저녁이 전화로 채워진다. 한편 같은 회기가 제출처마다 다시 쓰인다 — 받는 쪽도 쓰는 쪽도 같은 기록을 못 나눠 갖는다.
case.B로 이음새: 보호자로 열고 보호자로 닫는다 — A의 10분(②)이 B의 공유문이 되고, 도착 컷(C5.6)이 녹음기를 끝낸다. 그 다음 한 컷에서 넓어진다: 같은 일지가 제출처 양식으로도 나간다(C5.8). 받을 곳은 보호자만이 아니다.

name: 10분
flow: ② 상담사가 서서 10분 — 다음 아이 준비 사이에
situation: 허리 높이 프레임. 마주 선 두 사람의 손만 — 한쪽은 얇은 파일을 쥐고, 한쪽은 가볍게 손짓. 얼굴은 프레임 위.
caption: 기존 · "오늘 잘했어요, 블록 놀이 했고요" — 10분
prompt:
Documentary photograph aesthetic, unretouched, fine film grain.

A waiting room in a small child-counselling centre, framed at waist height. Two adults stand facing each other on the right: only their hands and midsections are in frame, one pair of hands folded holding a small folder, the other pair gesturing gently. Neither face is in frame, both heads above the top edge. The moment of the ten-minute talk. Polite, brief, unposed.

FG: a bench corner, slightly below centre. MG: the two pairs of hands, occupying the right third. BG: a plain wall and a low shelf, softly defocused.

Light: cool afternoon daylight from a window on the right, soft and flat; the left side falls into gentle shade.

Composition: rule of thirds. The two pairs of hands fill the right third; the lower left quadrant is calm bare bench and plain wall, left clear for copy added later.

Angle: eye-level at waist height, with comfortable margin around the subject on all sides.

Focus: hard focus on the gesturing hand. Set to 50mm, medium depth of field so the background stays readable during a slow push in.

Tone: Low Saturation Gray palette, muted grey-green and warm beige. Natural skin texture with visible pores, matte skin with no shine, believable proportions and natural hands.

The subject reads clearly against the background in tone and value.

Overall vibe: today went well, that is all there is time for.

The wall is plain and unbranded, the folder plain and free of print, every surface clean and free of lettering.
